one_liner: Platform for building, deploying, and hosting static sites and web apps, with a REST API for sites, deploys, and forms.

auth.evidence_quote: If you're making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2. This allows users to authorize your application to use Netlify on their behalf without having to copy/paste API tokens or touch sensitive login info.
auth.notes: Netlify calls the direct-use credential a 'personal access token' (PAT), used as a Bearer token, not called an API key.

access.notes: Free Netlify account can generate a PAT immediately; OAuth apps are self-registered in user settings, no review mentioned in the fetched page.

api.notes: Breadth not counted from the reference index this pass (estimated moderate from general knowledge of Netlify's API surface); official remote MCP server confirmed at https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp.

verdict.rationale: Free account, PAT or OAuth2 auth, and an official MCP server make this buildable now.
